data.name: Itisha
data.gender_notes: Itisha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Iti (this) + Isa (desire): The one who fulfills all desires. The name Itisha carries the meaning “Desire, Wish” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Itisha usually hope their child will grow to embody desire, wish and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the deep longing and yearning for the divine.
data.etymology: Itisha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desire, Wish.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Itisha total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Itisha holds great significance in Hindu culture, as it is associated with the fulfillment of desires. In Hindu mythology, there are several goddesses and deities who are believed to grant wishes and fulfill desires. Itisha, as a name, is a reflection of this belief and serves as a reminder of the divine power that can grant our deepest desires.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Itisha is rooted in the understanding that true happiness and fulfillment come not from worldly desires but from within. Itisha, as a name, serves as a reminder that the ultimate desire should be to seek spiritual growth and connection with the divine. It encourages us to look beyond material possessions and experiences and focus on inner peace, contentment, and self-realization.
